findings.title: README shipping-VAT rule rewritten to match new behaviour, contradicting the spec
findings.why: The README states it is authoritative: 'when the code and this list disagree' the list wins. The commit changed it from 'Shipping is subject to VAT at the standard rate (22%)' to 'Shipping carries no VAT', and removed shipping VAT from the total. The commit's own spec says 'README is authoritative; no README change needed' and FR-004 keeps total = goods + shipping + VAT + shipping VAT. None of the three reported defects (lower-case SKU, €50.00 threshold, line VAT rounding) concerns shipping VAT. The code and tests (src/tax.ts, src/pricing.ts, src/invoices.ts, src/receipt.ts, test/orders.test.ts) were changed to follow the new README. Customers lose the shipping VAT line and orders are undercharged by 22% of shipping.

findings.title: shippingVat now always returns 0, removing required shipping VAT
findings.why: The original README required VAT on shipping at 22%, and the spec's FR-004 still keeps the shipping VAT term. Returning 0 means totalCents in src/pricing.ts omits that VAT. Both the receipt 'VAT on shipping' line (src/receipt.ts) and the invoice's shipping row (src/invoices.ts, now added at rate 0) change as a result.

findings.title: Receipt no longer shows the 'VAT on shipping' line
findings.why: The original README says shipping VAT is 'shown on its own line of the receipt'. The commit removes that line unrequested.

findings.title: Invoice VAT summary shows shipping at rate 0 instead of the standard rate
findings.why: The original behaviour counted shipping in the standard-rate row. Now shipping net is added to the 0% row, which changes the VAT summary on invoices without being a requested fix.

findings.title: Unrequested behaviour changes to coupons and cancellation, outside the spec
findings.why: The spec covers only SKU lookup, the free-shipping threshold and line VAT rounding. The commit also changes the coupon expiry boundary (src/coupons.ts), the coupon base after volume discounts (src/pricing.ts) and the giveBack argument (src/orders.ts). These follow the README and look correct, but spec.md, plan.md and tasks.md do not mention them, so the change cannot be traced to the stated requirements.

findings.title: Plan names test/catalog.test.ts, which was not changed
findings.why: The plan lists test/catalog.test.ts, but the commit adds the SKU tests to test/orders.test.ts instead. It also omits the coupons, pricing and shipping-VAT changes.
